items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: I'd like you to meet Fran." That's his wife.

ctx.x: It's tough on the lip, even.

Yeah. If there had been another horn or something. So he said, "Look, don't worry about it. Just go on down with me," he says. You know how Joe is. "Don't worry about it." He says -- and you had to play with a mute in there. So I says, "Well, okay, let me think it over." And then he calls back again and he says, "I'll tell you what. Come on by the house. I'd like you to meet Fran." That's his wife.

I'd never met her. So they was living on the east side somewhere, so I went over. "Bring your wife." We went over and fooled around with them, and had snacks, and he'd play his horn awhile and then I'd play awhile, and play the piano. So he says, "I ain't worried about it. Don't you worry about it." And I said, "Now, don't expect too much out of me over there." He said, "Look, I ain't even worried, so don't you worry." All right, we opened up, we did good. We had Charlie Mingus there on bass, Jo Jones on drums,…
